name: freehire
long_description:
Search 4.9M+ unique open jobs from 437 sources, with 680K+ company profiles and 178 ATS platforms in the catalogue. Find roles by stack, seniority, location, work mode and salary. Read full postings, compare advertised pay and track your shortlist. This local MCP server also supports CV tailoring through the freehire API.

The local server uses a personal API key, including a key already stored by the freehire CLI. For a hosted connection with public search and optional OAuth account access, use https://freehire.me/api/v1/mcp. Saving or marking a job applied updates tracking; it does not submit an application to an employer.

Catalogue figures verified on 5 November 2026. Live figures: https://freehire.me/open.

freehire_token.title: freehire.me API key
freehire_token.description: Create one at freehire.me under the account menu -> API keys. Leave blank if the freehire.me CLI already stored a key in ~/.freehire/creds.json — the server reads that.
